still_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied 16x16 Minecraft heavy-liquid surface texture. Produce a 4 columns by 4 rows animation atlas: 16 equally sized touching square frames, no gaps, lines, labels or border. Each frame is exactly 16x16 logical pixels enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor pixels. Preserve the supplied material's identity: very dark burgundy liquid, thin branching crimson-red luminous veins and the restrained palette. Preserve its flat pixel-art texture character; no perspective or lighting, NO circular bubbles, NO flame tongues, no lava-orange, no additional objects. The frames show slow dense convection: existing veins drift only a little, some thin red paths brighten and fade gently, liquid currents move slowly. Keep dark areas dominant and roughly equal brightness between all frames. First frame looks very close to the source image; last frame loops gently back to first. Seamless tiled material in each frame. Opaque throughout; no text. It is a toxic ocean viewed from above, not rock, carpet or fire. Exact 4x4 square atlas fills output edge-to-edge.
flow_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied 32x32 Minecraft flowing toxic liquid texture. Slow dense downward convection, existing vein paths drift slightly and brighten/fade; keep most area very dark and all frames similar average brightness.
